executive_summary: The client seeks to reduce FNOL to adjuster assignment time and misrouting of claims through an intelligent claims triage and document intelligence platform. The proposed solution will integrate with existing systems, provide claim summaries, and implement fraud detection while ensuring no claims are automatically declined. Key risks include potential conflicts with hardware procurement timelines, security compliance issues, and the risk of late hardware delivery.

requirements.title: Reduce FNOL to adjuster assignment time
requirements.description: Reduce average time from FNOL to correct adjuster assignment to under 4 working hours.
requirements.source_quote: Reduce the average time from FNOL to correct adjuster assignment from 3.8 working days to under 4 working hours for straightforward claims.

requirements.title: Reduce misrouted claims
requirements.description: Reduce misrouted claims from 22% to below 5%.
requirements.source_quote: Reduce misrouted claims from 22% to below 5%.

requirements.title: Provide concise claim summary
requirements.description: Provide adjusters with a concise, trustworthy summary of each claim.
requirements.source_quote: Give adjusters a concise, trustworthy summary of each claim so they can start assessment without opening every attachment.

requirements.title: Detect potential fraud
requirements.description: Detect and surface anomalies to the SIU for potentially fraudulent claims.
requirements.source_quote: Improve early detection of potentially fraudulent claims by surfacing anomalies to the Special Investigations Unit (SIU), without automatically declining any claim.

requirements.title: Ingest claim documents
requirements.description: Ingest claim documents from all four lodgement channels.
requirements.source_quote: - Ingestion of claim documents from all four lodgement channels.

requirements.title: Document classification and data extraction
requirements.description: Perform document classification, data extraction and claim summarisation.
requirements.source_quote: - Document classification, data extraction and claim summarisation.

requirements.title: Triage claims
requirements.description: Perform triage: complexity scoring, line-of-business routing and adjuster queue assignment.
requirements.source_quote: - Triage: complexity scoring, line-of-business routing and adjuster queue assignment.

requirements.title: Fraud indicator flagging
requirements.description: Flag claims for fraud indicators for referral to SIU.
requirements.source_quote: - Fraud-indicator flagging for referral to SIU.

requirements.title: Adjuster-facing AI outputs
requirements.description: Provide an adjuster-facing view of the AI outputs.
requirements.source_quote: - An adjuster-facing view of the AI outputs (see section 6 regarding where this must live).

requirements.title: Monitoring and evaluation tooling
requirements.description: Provide monitoring, evaluation and model governance tooling for AI components.
requirements.source_quote: - Monitoring, evaluation and model governance tooling for the AI components.

requirements.title: Multi-channel ingestion
requirements.description: Ingest claim documents from various sources.
requirements.source_quote: **FR-1 Multi-channel ingestion.** The solution shall ingest claim documents from the web portal, mobile app, monitored email inboxes and scanned paper batches, and associate every document with the correct claim number in ClaimsNet.

requirements.title: Document classification
requirements.description: Classify documents into Corvane's taxonomy.
requirements.source_quote: **FR-2 Document classification.** The solution shall classify each incoming document into Corvane's document taxonomy (currently 27 document types, to be provided after contract award) with a confidence score.

requirements.title: Data extraction
requirements.description: Extract key fields from claim documents.
requirements.source_quote: **FR-3 Data extraction.** The solution shall extract key fields from claim forms, police reports, repair estimates and invoices, including at minimum: policy number, incident date, incident location, vehicle registration (motor), third-party details, itemised amounts and totals.

requirements.title: Handle low-quality documents
requirements.description: Handle handwritten and low-quality images.
requirements.source_quote: **FR-4 Handwriting and image quality.** The solution shall handle handwritten claim forms and low-quality phone photographs of documents, and shall flag documents that cannot be read reliably rather than guessing.

requirements.title: Generate claim summary
requirements.description: Generate a plain-language summary of each claim.
requirements.source_quote: **FR-5 Claim summarisation.** The solution shall generate a plain-language summary of each claim (no more than 200 words) for the assigned adjuster, highlighting the incident, the parties involved, amounts claimed and any missing documents. Every factual statement in the summary must be traceable to a source document.

requirements.title: Triage and routing
requirements.description: Route claims based on complexity score.
requirements.source_quote: **FR-6 Triage and routing.** The solution shall assign each claim a complexity score and route it to the appropriate line-of-business queue and adjuster tier, using rules configurable by Corvane's claims operations team without vendor involvement.

requirements.title: Identify fraud indicators
requirements.description: Solution must identify potential fraud indicators.
requirements.source_quote: **FR-7 Fraud indicators.** The solution shall identify potential fraud indicators (for example, inconsistent dates, duplicate invoices across claims, altered documents) and refer flagged claims to SIU with an explanation.

requirements.title: Never automatically decline claims
requirements.description: Solution must not automatically decline or close claims.
requirements.source_quote: The solution must never automatically decline or close a claim.

requirements.title: Human review
requirements.description: Allow adjusters to review and correct AI-generated outputs.
requirements.source_quote: **FR-8 Human review.** Adjusters shall be able to accept, correct or reject every AI-generated classification, extracted field and summary. Corrections shall be captured and made available for model improvement.

requirements.title: Capture corrections for model improvement
requirements.description: Corrections must be captured and made available for model improvement.
requirements.source_quote: Corrections shall be captured and made available for model improvement.

requirements.title: Missing information requests
requirements.description: Draft requests for missing documents.
requirements.source_quote: **FR-9 Missing information requests.** Where mandatory documents are missing, the solution should draft a request to the customer for the adjuster to review and send.

requirements.title: Provide operational dashboards
requirements.description: Operational dashboards must cover specified metrics.
requirements.source_quote: The solution shall provide operational dashboards covering volumes, processing times, routing accuracy, extraction accuracy and adjuster override rates.

requirements.title: Explain routing decisions
requirements.description: Routing decisions must be explainable in business terms.
requirements.source_quote: Corvane's claims operations managers have also asked that every routing decision be explainable in business terms, so that when a customer or the regulator asks why a claim was handled in a certain way, a team leader can answer without involving IT.

requirements.title: Support Bahasa Malaysia
requirements.description: Support for Bahasa Malaysia documents is expected from the pilot.
requirements.source_quote: Many of our customers in Sabah and in the northern region correspond in Bahasa Malaysia, and a meaningful minority of documents (we estimate 10 to 15%) arrive in Chinese. Support for Bahasa Malaysia documents is expected from the pilot.

requirements.title: Chinese document support
requirements.description: Support for Chinese documents is welcome but not required.
requirements.source_quote: Many of our customers in Sabah and in the northern region correspond in Bahasa Malaysia, and a meaningful minority of documents (we estimate 10 to 15%) arrive in Chinese. Support for Bahasa Malaysia documents is expected from the pilot. If Chinese-language documents could also be handled, that would be welcome, although we recognise this may come later and it is not a condition of award.

requirements.title: Cut manual document keying effort
requirements.description: Cut manual document keying effort by at least 60% within twelve months of go-live.
requirements.source_quote: Cut manual document keying effort by at least 60% within twelve months of go-live.

requirements.title: Historical claim documents
requirements.description: Approximately 2.1 million documents from the last five years may be usable for training and evaluation.
requirements.source_quote: Roughly 9 TB of historical claim documents exist, of which approximately 2.1 million documents relate to claims closed in the last five years and may be usable for training and evaluation, subject to the data protection constraints in section 8.

requirements.title: Two data centres
requirements.description: The Company operates two data centres in Malaysia.
requirements.source_quote: The Company operates two data centres in Malaysia (primary in Cyberjaya, secondary in Johor) and has a limited Microsoft Azure footprint (Southeast Asia region) used today only for email and collaboration tools.

requirements.title: Single document processing time
requirements.description: Classification and extraction for a single document must complete within 30 seconds.
requirements.source_quote: **NFR-1 Performance.** Classification and extraction for a single document should complete within 30 seconds of receipt at the 95th percentile.

requirements.title: Claim triage and routing availability
requirements.description: Triage and routing for a complete claim must be available in real time.
requirements.source_quote: Triage and routing for a complete claim should be available to the adjuster in real time once all FNOL documents are received.

requirements.title: Daily claim throughput
requirements.description: The solution must sustain peak volumes of 2,500 claims per day.
requirements.source_quote: **NFR-2 Throughput.** The solution shall sustain peak volumes of 2,500 claims per day (approximately three times the daily average), as experienced during the year-end monsoon flooding season, without degradation beyond the targets in NFR-1.

requirements.title: Business hour availability
requirements.description: The production service must achieve 99.5% availability during business hours.
requirements.source_quote: **NFR-3 Availability.** The production service shall achieve 99.5% availability during business hours (08:00 to 20:00, Monday to Saturday).

requirements.title: Planned maintenance outside business hours
requirements.description: Planned maintenance must be scheduled outside business hours.
requirements.source_quote: Planned maintenance must be scheduled outside these hours.

requirements.title: Continued claim flow during AI unavailability
requirements.description: Claims must continue to flow into ClaimsNet using the existing manual process.
requirements.source_quote: **NFR-4 Resilience.** If the AI components are unavailable, claims must continue to flow into ClaimsNet using the existing manual process, with no loss of documents.

requirements.title: Scalability for other lines of business
requirements.description: The architecture must allow other lines of business to be onboarded by Corvane staff without re-architecture.
requirements.source_quote: **NFR-5 Scalability.** The architecture should allow other lines of business and additional document types to be onboarded by Corvane staff without re-architecture.

requirements.title: Adjuster-facing interface accessibility
requirements.description: Adjuster-facing interfaces must meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
requirements.source_quote: **NFR-6 Accessibility and usability.** Adjuster-facing interfaces shall meet WCAG 2.1 AA.

requirements.title: Version control for models and prompts
requirements.description: All models, prompts, and configuration must be version-controlled.
requirements.source_quote: **NFR-7 Maintainability.** All models, prompts and configuration shall be version-controlled, and every production output shall be traceable to the model and configuration version that produced it.

requirements.title: Delete working copies within 30 days
requirements.description: Working copies must be deleted within 30 days of claim closure.
requirements.source_quote: Working copies of documents held by the solution must be deleted within 30 days of claim closure.

requirements.title: Accommodate SIU investigations
requirements.description: Solution must accommodate longer document retention for SIU investigations.
requirements.source_quote: Bidders should note that the same documents may be required for SIU investigations for considerably longer, and the solution design must accommodate this.

requirements.title: Evaluate model quality
requirements.description: Bidders must explain how they will evaluate model quality.
requirements.source_quote: Bidders should explain how they will evaluate model quality before and after go-live, including how they will measure extraction accuracy, routing accuracy and summary faithfulness, and how they will detect drift once in production.

requirements.title: Compliance with PDPA
requirements.description: Solution must comply with PDPA and other regulations.
requirements.source_quote: Corvane is regulated by Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) and must comply with the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA) as amended, BNM's Risk Management in Technology (RMiT) policy, and its own information security standards.

requirements.title: Data residency within Malaysia
requirements.description: Customer data must be stored and processed in Corvane's Malaysian data centres.
requirements.source_quote: All customer personal data, claim documents and derived data (including extracted fields, embeddings and model outputs) must be stored and processed within Corvane's own Malaysian data centres.

requirements.title: Minimize personal data exposure
requirements.description: Personal data must be minimally exposed and masked in adjuster-facing summaries.
requirements.source_quote: The solution shall minimise exposure of personal data, mask identity card numbers in all adjuster-facing summaries except where explicitly needed, and shall not use personal data for any purpose other than claims handling and the improvement of the claims models.

requirements.title: Audit trail logging
requirements.description: AI outputs, human overrides, and routing decisions must be logged with timestamps and details.
requirements.source_quote: Every AI output, every human override, and every routing decision shall be logged with a timestamp, user or system identity, input references and the model version used. Audit logs shall be immutable and retained for seven years.

requirements.title: Role-based access control
requirements.description: Access must be role-based, with specific permissions for SIU staff and claims managers.
requirements.source_quote: Access shall be role-based. SIU fraud flags shall be visible only to SIU staff and designated claims managers, not to all adjusters.

requirements.title: Annual security testing
requirements.description: Solution must undergo independent penetration testing annually.
requirements.source_quote: The solution shall undergo independent penetration testing before go-live and annually thereafter. Findings rated high or critical must be remediated before go-live.

requirements.title: Support model risk management
requirements.description: Bidder must support Corvane's model risk management process.
requirements.source_quote: The bidder shall support Corvane's model risk management process, including documentation of model purpose, training data, known limitations, evaluation results and bias testing across customer segments.

requirements.title: Disclose third-party models
requirements.description: Third-party models must be disclosed, including licensing and hosting details.
requirements.source_quote: Where foundation models or large language models are used, the bidder shall disclose the model, its licence, where it is hosted, and confirm that no Corvane data is used to train third-party models.

requirements.title: Technical architecture evaluation
requirements.description: Technical architecture, security and compliance is weighted 25%.
requirements.source_quote: Technical architecture, security and compliance | 25%

requirements.title: Use ClaimsNet
requirements.description: The solution must use ClaimsNet for claims management.
requirements.source_quote: Claims are managed in **ClaimsNet**, an in-house claims management system built on Java and an Oracle 12c database in 2011.

requirements.title: Limited SOAP web services
requirements.description: ClaimsNet exposes a limited set of SOAP web services.
requirements.source_quote: ClaimsNet exposes a limited set of SOAP web services; there is no REST API today, and the vendor team that built it has largely moved on.

requirements.title: Use IBM MQ
requirements.description: Policy data must be accessed through IBM MQ.
requirements.source_quote: Policy data sits in a mainframe-hosted policy administration system (PAS) that is accessed through a message queue integration layer (IBM MQ).

requirements.title: Near real-time read access
requirements.description: Near real-time read access to policy coverage details is allowed.
requirements.source_quote: Read access to policy coverage details is possible in near real time; write access is not permitted for this project.

requirements.title: Use DMS
requirements.description: Documents must be stored in the document management system (DMS).
requirements.source_quote: Documents are stored in a document management system (DMS) on a network file share, with metadata held in ClaimsNet.

requirements.title: Use Active Directory
requirements.description: Identity must be managed through on-premise Active Directory.
requirements.source_quote: Identity is managed through on-premise Active Directory. All internal applications must use single sign-on.

requirements.title: Description of new interfaces
requirements.description: Bidders must describe how new interfaces will be built and maintained.
requirements.source_quote: Where new interfaces are required, the bidder shall describe how they will be built and who will maintain them.

requirements.title: Prefer not to modify ClaimsNet's core codebase
requirements.description: Corvane prefers not to modify ClaimsNet's core codebase.
requirements.source_quote: Corvane prefers not to modify ClaimsNet's core codebase; minor additions to its user interface are acceptable if delivered through its plugin framework.

requirements.title: Policy coverage lookups using existing IBM MQ
requirements.description: Policy coverage lookups must use the existing IBM MQ integration layer.
requirements.source_quote: **INT-2** Policy coverage lookups shall use the existing IBM MQ integration layer.

requirements.title: No writing to policy administration system
requirements.description: The solution must not write to the policy administration system.
requirements.source_quote: The solution shall not write to the policy administration system.

requirements.title: Working copies retention
requirements.description: Working copies of documents may be held only as needed for processing.
requirements.source_quote: The solution may hold working copies only for as long as needed for processing, subject to the retention rules in section 8.

requirements.title: User authentication through Active Directory
requirements.description: Users must be authenticated through Corvane's Active Directory using single sign-on.
requirements.source_quote: **INT-4** The solution shall authenticate users through Corvane's Active Directory using single sign-on.

requirements.title: Avoid new dependencies on nightly SFTP batch interfaces
requirements.description: Bidders should avoid designing new dependencies on the nightly SFTP batch interfaces.
requirements.source_quote: The nightly SFTP batch interfaces are expected to be retired within two years. Bidders should avoid designing new dependencies on them.

requirements.title: Understand and maintain solution
requirements.description: Corvane's data science team must be able to understand, maintain and retrain the solution.
requirements.source_quote: Corvane's own data science team (currently six people) must be able to understand, maintain and retrain the solution after handover.

requirements.title: Knowledge transfer and training
requirements.description: Provide knowledge transfer and training for Corvane's IT, data science and claims teams.
requirements.source_quote: - Knowledge transfer and training for Corvane's IT, data science and claims teams.

requirements.title: Assume 16-20 weeks for GPU infrastructure
requirements.description: Assume 16-20 weeks for GPU infrastructure procurement, delivery and installation.
requirements.source_quote: Corvane does not currently own GPU infrastructure in either data centre. Our infrastructure team estimates that procurement, delivery and installation of new server hardware typically takes 16 to 20 weeks from purchase order, and capital purchases above MYR 1 million require Board approval at its quarterly meeting. Bidders should describe their assumptions about compute infrastructure clearly.

requirements.title: Budget range
requirements.description: The budget must be between MYR 6.5 million and MYR 8 million.
requirements.source_quote: The indicative budget envelope for this workstream is **MYR 6.5 million to MYR 8 million** over the initial contract term (contract award to handover),

requirements.title: Discovery and design fixed price
requirements.description: A fixed price for discovery and design must be provided.
requirements.source_quote: - A fixed price for discovery and design.

requirements.title: Pilot fixed or capped price
requirements.description: A fixed or capped price for the pilot must be provided.
requirements.source_quote: - A fixed or capped price for the pilot.

requirements.title: Rollout phases pricing
requirements.description: Rollout phases can be priced as time-and-materials or fixed price, with rate cards.
requirements.source_quote: - A time-and-materials or fixed price, at the bidder's option, for the rollout phases, with rate cards.

requirements.title: Annual licence and support costs
requirements.description: Annual licence and support costs for five years after handover must be provided.
requirements.source_quote: - Annual licence and support costs for five years after handover.

requirements.title: Infrastructure or hardware recommendations
requirements.description: Recommendations for infrastructure or hardware must be provided, with indicative costs.
requirements.source_quote: - Any infrastructure or hardware the bidder recommends Corvane procure, with indicative costs, shown separately.

requirements.title: Milestone-based payment
requirements.description: Payment must be milestone-based, with at least 15% linked to measurable outcomes.
requirements.source_quote: Payment will be milestone-based. Corvane expects at least 15% of the services fee to be linked to achievement of measurable outcomes, for example routing accuracy and keying effort reduction, measured after the pilot.

requirements.title: Intellectual property rights
requirements.description: All intellectual property in custom work products must vest in Corvane.
requirements.source_quote: Corvane's standard terms require that all intellectual property in custom work products, including prompts, configurations, fine-tuned model weights and evaluation datasets created specifically for Corvane, vest in Corvane.

requirements.title: Describe comparable implementations
requirements.description: Bidders must describe at least two comparable implementations.
requirements.source_quote: Bidders should describe at least two comparable implementations in insurance or financial services, preferably in Southeast Asia, with client references.

requirements.title: Delivery lead and solution architect
requirements.description: A named delivery lead and solution architect must remain on the engagement.
requirements.source_quote: The proposed team must include a named delivery lead and a named solution architect who will remain on the engagement through at least full motor rollout.

requirements.title: Blended onshore and offshore team
requirements.description: A blended onshore and offshore team is required.
requirements.source_quote: Corvane expects a blended onshore and offshore team; however, any personnel with access to production data must be based in Malaysia and hold appropriate security clearance as determined by Corvane.

requirements.title: Solution fit evaluation
requirements.description: Solution fit to functional and non-functional requirements is weighted 30%.
requirements.source_quote: Solution fit to functional and non-functional requirements | 30%

requirements.title: Delivery approach evaluation
requirements.description: Delivery approach, timeline realism and team is weighted 20%.
requirements.source_quote: Delivery approach, timeline realism and team | 20%

requirements.title: Commercial value evaluation
requirements.description: Commercial value and total cost of ownership is weighted 15%.
requirements.source_quote: Commercial value and total cost of ownership | 15%

requirements.title: Capability transfer evaluation
requirements.description: Capability transfer and ongoing support is weighted 10%.
requirements.source_quote: Capability transfer and ongoing support | 10%

requirements.title: Electronic submission
requirements.description: Proposals must be submitted electronically.
requirements.source_quote: Proposals must be submitted electronically to the procurement portal by the due date stated above. Late submissions will not be considered.

requirements.title: Executive summary length
requirements.description: Executive summary must be no more than two pages.
requirements.source_quote:
Proposals should contain:

1. An executive summary of no more than two pages.

requirements.title: Requirements compliance matrix
requirements.description: Compliance matrix must respond to every requirement.
requirements.source_quote: 2. A requirements compliance matrix responding to every FR, NFR, INT and SEC requirement.

requirements.title: Solution architecture
requirements.description: Solution architecture must include deployment diagram.
requirements.source_quote: 3. Solution architecture, including a deployment diagram showing where every component runs and where data is stored and processed.

requirements.title: Delivery plan and milestones
requirements.description: Delivery plan and milestones must be included.
requirements.source_quote: 4. Delivery plan and milestones, with key assumptions and dependencies on Corvane.

requirements.title: Team structure and CVs
requirements.description: Team structure and CVs must be provided.
requirements.source_quote: 5. Team structure and CVs of named personnel.

requirements.title: Commercial proposal
requirements.description: Commercial proposal must be in a separate document.
requirements.source_quote: 6. Commercial proposal, in a separate document.

requirements.title: Risks and mitigations
requirements.description: Risks and proposed mitigations must be included.
requirements.source_quote: 7. Risks and proposed mitigations.

requirements.title: Proposal length
requirements.description: Proposal main body must not exceed 40 pages.
requirements.source_quote: The main body of the proposal should not exceed 40 pages excluding appendices.

requirements.title: Clarification questions submission
requirements.description: Clarification questions must be submitted by 5 February 2027.
requirements.source_quote: Clarification questions must be submitted in writing through the procurement portal by 5 February 2027; Corvane will publish anonymised answers to all bidders by 12 February 2027.

requirements.title: Full rollout by 30 September 2027
requirements.description: Full motor rollout must be completed by 30 September 2027.
requirements.source_quote: Full motor rollout, all offices | 30 September 2027

requirements.title: Home, travel and small-commercial lines live by 31 January 2028
requirements.description: Home, travel and small-commercial lines must be live by 31 January 2028.
requirements.source_quote: Home, travel and small-commercial lines live | 31 January 2028

requirements.title: Handover to support by 31 March 2028
requirements.description: Handover to Corvane support must be completed by 31 March 2028.
requirements.source_quote: Handover to Corvane support | 31 March 2028

requirements.title: Pilot go-live fixed
requirements.description: Pilot go-live date is fixed at 30 June 2027.
requirements.source_quote: The pilot go-live date of 30 June 2027 is fixed and is linked to a commitment made to the Board. Bidders proposing a later pilot date will need to provide an exceptionally strong justification.

approach.summary: Develop a claims processing platform that integrates with ClaimsNet, DMS, and Active Directory, ensuring no core codebase modifications.
components: Compliance with PDPA and data residency
Scalability for other lines of business
Version control for models and prompts
Continued claim flow during AI unavailability
Home, travel and small-commercial lines live by 31 January 2028
approach.rationale: This approach respects the constraints and ensures compliance with the client's requirements.

approach.summary: Provide a concise claim summary for adjusters.
approach.rationale: This feature will help adjusters quickly understand the claim context and make informed decisions.

approach.summary: Implement a fraud detection system that flags potential fraud cases.
approach.rationale: This system will help in early detection and prevention of fraudulent claims.

approach.summary: Generate a claim summary to provide a quick overview to adjusters.
approach.rationale: This will streamline the claims processing workflow and improve adjuster efficiency.

approach.summary: Triage and route claims based on predefined criteria and flag potential fraud cases.
approach.rationale: This ensures efficient claim handling and early fraud detection.

approach.summary: Ensure that no claims are automatically declined without human review.
approach.rationale: This prevents unjustified claim rejections and maintains customer trust.

approach.summary: Provide a human review interface for claims.
approach.rationale: This ensures that all claims are reviewed by a human before final processing.

approach.summary: Capture corrections for model improvement during the review process.
approach.rationale: This will continuously improve the AI models and their accuracy.

approach.summary: Request missing information from claimants when necessary.
approach.rationale: This ensures that all claims have the necessary information for processing.

approach.summary: Provide operational dashboards for monitoring claim processing and AI performance.
approach.rationale: This will help in real-time monitoring and performance optimization.

approach.summary: Ensure compliance with PDPA, data residency, and other security and compliance requirements.
approach.rationale: This will protect sensitive data and ensure legal and regulatory compliance.

approach.summary: Integrate with ClaimsNet, DMS, IBM MQ, Active Directory, and other legacy systems without modifying core codebases.
approach.rationale: This approach respects the client's constraints and ensures seamless integration.

approach.summary: Ensure the solution is maintainable, scalable, and can be supported over the long term.
approach.rationale: This will ensure the solution remains relevant and effective over time.

approach.summary: Deliver the solution by the specified timelines and phases.
approach.rationale: This will ensure the project is completed on time and within the defined phases.

risks.title: Fixed pilot date conflicts with hardware procurement timeline
risks.description: The fixed pilot go-live date of 30 June 2027 conflicts with the 16-20 week hardware procurement timeline, which may not be completed by the required date.
risks.mitigation: Agree an interim hosting option for the pilot, or re-baseline the date at contract award.

risks.title: Ambiguity in 'near real-time' data processing
risks.description: The requirement for near real-time data processing is vague and could lead to disputes over what constitutes 'near real-time'.
risks.mitigation: Clarify the definition of 'near real-time' with the client and document the agreed definition in the contract.

risks.title: Security compliance with PDPA and data residency
risks.description: Ensuring compliance with PDPA and data residency within Malaysia while minimizing personal data exposure is complex and may introduce significant risks.
risks.mitigation: Conduct a detailed data protection impact assessment and ensure regular audits to maintain compliance.

risks.title: Risk of late hardware procurement
risks.description: The risk of late hardware procurement could delay the pilot and full rollout, impacting the project timeline.
risks.mitigation: Develop a contingency plan for hardware procurement and include it in the risk management plan.

risks.title: Ambiguity in 'should' requirements
risks.description: The 'should' requirements, such as supporting Bahasa Malaysia and Chinese document support, are not clearly defined and could lead to disputes.
risks.mitigation: Clarify the scope and expected outcomes of these requirements with the client.

risks.title: Risk of exceeding budget
risks.description: The budget range of MYR 6.5 million to MYR 8 million may be underestimated, and the risk of exceeding this budget is high.
risks.mitigation: Perform a detailed cost analysis and include a contingency reserve in the budget.

assumptions.statement: ClaimsNet's core codebase will not be modified.
assumptions.rationale: The client has explicitly stated that no core codebase modifications are allowed.

assumptions.statement: The solution will leverage existing interfaces and avoid new dependencies on nightly SFTP batch interfaces.
assumptions.rationale: This minimizes the risk and complexity of the solution.

assumptions.statement: The solution will be designed to handle low-quality documents efficiently.
assumptions.rationale: This ensures the system can process a wide range of document types and quality levels.

assumptions.statement: The solution will be version-controlled and traceable to ensure maintainability and compliance with regulatory requirements.
assumptions.rationale: This will facilitate model updates and ensure compliance with data protection regulations.

assumptions.statement: The solution will be scalable to accommodate other lines of business and additional document types.
assumptions.rationale: This ensures the solution can be extended to support future business needs.
